title: Data Type Propagation Examples
text: Set data type and scaling of propagated signal based on information from reference signals, 3 inputs, no direct feedthrough, {2.1. Propagated scaling (Slope, e.g. 2^-9 or [Slope Bias], e.g. [1.25 3])} sets Slope or; {1. Propagated data type} sets the mode of specifying propagated data type Inherit via propagation, {1.1. Propagated data type (e.g. fixdt(1,16), fixdt(’single’))} sets the propagated data type fixdt, {1.1 If any reference input is double, output is} sets the output data type when a reference input, {1.2 If any reference input is single, output is} sets the output data type when a reference input, {1.3 Is-Signed} sets the signedness of propagated data type IsSigned1, {1.4.1 Number-of-bits: Base} sets the number of bits for the base of the propagated data type, {1.4.2 Number-of-bits: Multiplicative adjustment} sets the number of bits for multiplicative adjustment of propagated data, {1.4.3 Number-of-bits: Additive adjustment} sets the number of bits for additive adjustment of propagated data, {1.4.4 Number-of-bits: Allowable final values} sets the allowable number of bits in propagated data, {2. Propagated scaling} sets the propagated scaling mode Inherit via propagation, {2.1. Values used to determine best precision scaling} sets the values to constrain precision, {2.1.1. Slope: Base} sets the slope for base of the propagated data type, {2.1.2. Slope: Multiplicative adjustment} sets the slope of multiplicative adjustment of propagated data, {2.1.3. Slope: Additive adjustment} sets the slope of additive adjustment of propagated data, {2.2.1. Bias: Base} sets the base bias, {2.2.2. Bias: Multiplicative adjustment} sets the multiplicative bias for propagated data and {2.3.2. Bias: Additive adjustment} sets the additive bias for propagated data type. Values come from the instance.

params.name: 1. Propagated data type
params.values: Mode of specifying propagated data type Inherit via propagation rule (default) | Specify via dialog

params.name: 1.1. Propagated data type (e.g. fixdt(1,16), fixdt(’single’))
params.values: Propagated data type fixdt(1,16) (default) | data type string

params.name: 1.1 If any reference input is double, output is
params.values: Output data type when a reference input is double double (default) | single

params.name: 1.2 If any reference input is single, output is
params.values: Output data type when a reference input is single single (default) | double

params.name: 1.3 Is-Signed
params.values: Signedness of propagated data type IsSigned1 or IsSigned2 (default) | IsSigned1 | IsSigned2 | TRUE | FALSE

params.name: 1.4.1 Number-of-bits: Base
params.values: Number of bits for the base of the propagated data type max([NumBits1 NumBits2]) (default) | NumBits1 | NumBits2 | min([NumBits1 NumBits2]) | NumBits1+NumBits2

params.name: 1.4.2 Number-of-bits: Multiplicative adjustment
params.values: Number of bits for multiplicative adjustment of propagated data type 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: 1.4.3 Number-of-bits: Additive adjustment
params.values: Number of bits for additive adjustment of propagated data type 0 (default) | positive integer

params.name: 1.4.4 Number-of-bits: Allowable final values
params.values: Allowable number of bits in propagated data type ’-1’ (default) | scalar or vector of positive integers

params.name: 2. Propagated scaling
params.values: Propagated scaling mode Inherit via propagation rule (default) | Specify via dialog | Obtain via best precision

params.name: 2.1. Propagated scaling (Slope, e.g. 2^-9 or [Slope Bias], e.g. [1.25 3])
params.values: Slope or slope and bias 2^-10 | slope | slope and bias in square brackets

params.name: 2.1. Values used to determine best precision scaling
2.1.1. Slope: Base
params.values: Slope for base of the propagated data type min([Slope1 Slope2]) (default) | Slope1 | Slope2 | min([Slope1 Slope2]) | max([Bias1 Bias2]) | Slope1*Slope2 | Slope1/Slope2 | PosRange1 | PosRange2 | max([PosRange1 PosRange2]) | min([PosRange1 PosRange2]) | PosRange1*PosRange2 | PosRange1/PosRange2

params.name: 2.1.2. Slope: Multiplicative adjustment
params.values: Slope of multiplicative adjustment of propagated data type 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: 2.1.3. Slope: Additive adjustment
params.values: Slope of additive adjustment of propagated data type 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: 2.2.1. Bias: Base
params.values: Base bias for Prop Bias1 (default) | Bias2 | max([Bias1 Bias2]) | min([Bias1 Bias2]) | Bias1*Bias2 | Bias1/Bias2 | Bias1+Bias2 | Bias1-Bias2

params.name: 2.2.2. Bias: Multiplicative adjustment
params.values: Multiplicative bias for propagated data type 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: 2.3.2. Bias: Additive adjustment
params.values: Additive bias for propagated data type 0 (default) | scalar
